_comment: Hand-curated GL<->VK shader twin families for tools/gl_vk_feature_coverage.py. Keys are VK shader STEMS (shaders/vulkan/<stem>.<stage>); 'gl' lists the GL stems (shaders/<stem>.<stage>) the VK family re-implements. Same-name pairs and the _tier1/_native suffix rule are derived automatically and need no entry. 'why' cites the VK header that names its GL source.

cloud_shadow.why: cloud_shadow.frag header: Vulkan port of shaders/cloud.frag

hdri_sky.why: hdri_sky.frag header: Vulkan port of shaders/hdri_skybox.frag

legacy_shape_tier1.why: legacy_shape_tier1 header: port of shaders/gos_tex_vertex.*; the other three are the same legacy MLR family

postprocess_visual.why: postprocess_visual.frag header: conservative Visual-mode subset of the GL composite

screen_shadow_csm.why: screen_shadow_csm.frag header: VK CSM port of shaders/shadow_screen.frag

screen_shadow_static.why: screen_shadow_static.frag header: static-only port of shaders/shadow_screen.frag

shadow_debug_overlay.why: VK shadow debug overlay for the GL shadow_debug pass

shadow_prop.why: shadow_prop.vert header: reproduces shaders/shadow_static_prop.vert; .frag matches shadow_instanced.frag

terrain_decal_tier1.why: terrain_decal_tier1.frag header: port of shaders/decal.frag; VS shared with terrain_overlay.vert

terrain_tier1.why: terrain_tier1.vert header: port of terrain_lod_chunk.vert; terrain_tier1.frag ports gos_terrain.frag (glsl_port_diff lodNear)

terrain_tier1_skirt.why: terrain_tier1_skirt.vert header: reproduces terrain_lod_chunk.vert skirt path

vfx_particle.why: vfx_particle.vert header: port of particle_billboard.vert; vfx_mesh/tube_ribbon are the same VFX island

water_geom.why: water_geom.frag header: port of gos_terrain_water_mdi.frag; .vert ports gos_terrain_water_fast_mdi.vert

no_gl_twin.hud_color: native VK HUD pipeline; GL HUD goes through gos_vertex
no_gl_twin.hud_tex: native VK HUD pipeline; GL HUD goes through gos_tex_vertex
